gen-gf-warnes-gf-vend-sans: Warnes draws ink strokes that taper off before they touch, stretched out with generous tracking. Vend Sans follows with a ruler-straight line and an x-height that fills the row, sturdy where the heading is showy.
gen-irish-grover-gf-yaldevi: Playful and organic, Irish Grover stands tall. It makes words look sturdy and large with softly varied strokes, while Yaldevi, a plain sans, stays low-contrast and lets its open-eyed e do the quiet work.
gen-gf-oxanium-gf-sarpanch: Oxanium has a high x-height that makes its lowercase look big, with diagonals as thick as the uprights. And Sarpanch brings a compact, friendly sans whose lowercase e opens wide, a softer landing after that strict heading.
gen-gf-paprika-gf-schibsted-grotesk: Paprika's lowercase fills the line like capitals. It earns its keep big and short, while Schibsted Grotesk, a plain sans, keeps its tall-bowled e and a open and its terminals unclosed.
gen-luckiest-guy-gf-sen: Loud, cheerful, poured-ink lettering from Luckiest Guy, all one width, with a high mean line and an e that opens right. Sen, a plain sans, tracks tall lowercase in a constant line and balances that shout with quiet.
gen-megrim-gf-sintony: Megrim ends every stroke at one measured thickness, drawn with a single tip. Its heading is all angular, skyward lines, while Sintony, a sans-serif, gives a chunky, tall midzone and smooth curves that never clog.
gen-mystery-quest-gf-sofia-sans-semi-con: Nostalgic, bookish Mystery Quest opens its jaws on every curve, with compact ascenders over tall lowercase. Sofia Sans Semi Condensed, a clean sans, answers with lowercase nearly as tall as its capitals and wide entrances into each curve.
gen-press-start-2p-gf-tiktok-sans: Chunky retro fun with wide-set letters like cut-outs pinned far apart, courtesy of Press Start 2P. TikTok Sans, a sans-serif with a spacious c, rises close to cap height and reads smoothly.
gen-righteous-gf-sulphur-point: Commanding bowls fill the line in Righteous, like thin steel rod bent into every letter. Sulphur Point, a plain sans, keeps a steady marker-like weight with open gaps in c, e, s and a, so paragraphs read comfortably.
gen-tourney-gf-stack-sans-text: Bold and athletic, Tourney cuts every stroke to one width and stretches words with wide tracking. And Stack Sans Text, a plain sans, holds a marker-like line with big-bodied lowercase and curve endings kept well apart.
